notes.title: Dragonloop release now！
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42554654/fe9d814eb9696b6072ca34a7e260fdfdca348a4a.png"]

The game is priced at 36 yuan. The first release discount is 10%, and the discounted price is 32.4 yuan. In the game, you can experience



Special time and space cycle system



High-speed and smooth action system



5 major areas, more than 10 multi-purpose skills, 20+ elites and boss battles



As a team of 2 people, we have experienced more than three years of development and received a lot of support. The game is now available, and we hope that this game can bring you happiness.

notes.title: Prologue release now!
notes.notes:
The prologue is the content of the first hour of the official version, but the time system of the prologue is a separately customized 3-day loop.

The prologue save files are not interoperable with the official version.

Prologue: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781190/
